/-! # Finite-game transport for quotient hiding checks

The question law is unchanged. Decoding dual answer coordinates gives a
legacy strategy with at least the original value, on the same registers and
state and with every Pauli-question effect unchanged. In the other direction,
copying a legacy strategy preserves perfect PCC completeness and its dimension.
-/

module_doc:
/-! # Adding honest prefix guards preserves completeness

Changing a predicate only on zero measurement effects preserves its value.
Applying this observation to the local prefix guards keeps the honest state,
dimension and PCC property, while guard rejection can only reduce arbitrary
strategies' success.
-/

MIPRE.Introspection.PrefixGuard.game: /-- Retain the question law and add both local prefix checks. Raw question
payloads remain available to the original predicate. -/

module_doc:
/-! # Honest guarded quotient completeness with the actual register numbering

The source CL family remains on its given coordinate type. Only its honest
construction is expressed temporarily in the binary Weyl coordinates. Quotient
transport then returns the strategy to the original coordinates, with exact
dimension and with support certificates for both kinds of executable guards.
-/

/-! # Canonical auxiliary answer coding

Pauli payloads are left as bytes for the separate field-aware parser. The
other three answer shapes use full-register binary vectors and the existing
canonical tuple syntax. Valid raw tuples re-encode exactly, so same-type byte
consistency is exactly consistency of parsed answers.
-/

module_doc:
/-! # The bounded verifier as the source of introspection

The semantic source game has exactly the verifier's distribution and decision
predicate. Padding preserves perfect PCC strategies and can be removed from
the soundness conclusion without any additional error.
-/

/-! # The finite game at the compiler's canonical parameters

These definitions use the executable field, basis, selector, and register
numbering. The original answers retain their bounded finite alphabet.
-/

The map may depend on the question label. Auxiliary registers and source
answers are unchanged. Endpoint-local projection agreements suffice for all
mixed checks, and equality consistency survives every deterministic map.
-/
